steps.name: Server
procedure_descriptions: During [Outer Space](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0042), [OilRig](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0049) compromised an Israeli human resources site to use as a C2 server.(Citation: ESET OilRig Campaigns Sep 2023)

steps.name: Cloud Accounts
procedure_descriptions: During [Outer Space](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0042), [OilRig](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0049) created M365 email accounts to be used as part of C2.(Citation: ESET OilRig Campaigns Sep 2023)

steps.name: Malware
procedure_descriptions: For [Outer Space](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0042), [OilRig](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0049) created new implants including the [Solar](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1166) backdoor.(Citation: ESET OilRig Campaigns Sep 2023)

steps.name: Visual Basic
procedure_descriptions: During [Outer Space](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0042), [OilRig](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0049) used VBS droppers to deploy malware.(Citation: ESET OilRig Campaigns Sep 2023)

steps.name: Encrypted/Encoded File
procedure_descriptions: During [Outer Space](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0042), [OilRig](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0049) deployed VBS droppers with obfuscated strings.(Citation: ESET OilRig Campaigns Sep 2023)

steps.name: Browser Information Discovery
procedure_descriptions: During [Outer Space](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0042), [OilRig](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0049) used a Chrome data dumper named MKG.(Citation: ESET OilRig Campaigns Sep 2023)

steps.name: Web Protocols
procedure_descriptions: During [Outer Space](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0042), [OilRig](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0049) used HTTP to communicate between installed backdoors and compromised servers including via the Microsoft Exchange Web Services API.(Citation: ESET OilRig Campaigns Sep 2023)

steps.name: Ingress Tool Transfer
procedure_descriptions: During [Outer Space](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0042), [OilRig](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0049) downloaded additional tools to comrpomised infrastructure.(Citation: ESET OilRig Campaigns Sep 2023)
